portfolio-q.contentAnchor: A playlist holds four songs. Song 2 is deleted. What is the playlist like afterwards?
portfolio-q.cardText: 2 OF 12 · A playlist holds four songs. Song 2 is deleted. What is the playlist like afterwards? · A · Three songs, shuffled into a brand-new order · B · Three songs, with an empty gap where song 2 used to be · C · Three songs — and the songs that were after the gap have each moved up one place · D · Four songs, but song 2 is silent
